records.name: Pricing Lab for Turo hosts
records.tagline: See your real net per day on Turo. Hold your floor.

records.name: UXFix

Teams can understand what happened, reproduce issues faster, and create Jira tickets without manually recording videos or collecting technical details.

records.name: NextPick

records.name: Pankaj Kumar

Üyelik gerektirmeyen, mobil ve masaüstü cihazlarla uyumlu sade arayüzü sayesinde indirme işlemi yalnızca birkaç saniye sürer.

records.name: CloudFuze
records.tagline: Microsoft 365 Copilot to Google Gemini Migration Guide
records.description: CloudFuze helps enterprises seamlessly migrate Microsoft 365 Copilot conversations to Google Gemini while preserving AI context, conversation history, and knowledge. Ensure a secure, compliant transition to Google Workspace without losing valuable AI insights.

records.name: 789Bingo
records.tagline: Millionaire by Big Time Gaming
records.description: Experience the ultimate luxury with Millionaire by Big Time Gaming at 789Bingo! Spin for life-changing wins and exclusive BTG features. Start spinning now!

records.name: Rice Straw Pellet Machine
records.tagline: Rice Straw Pellet Machine
records.description: This rice straw pellet machine is an industrial-grade equipment for producing biomass pellets. It adapts to the high-fiber characteristics of rice straw, consistently producing high-quality fuel pellets. We also offer customized solutions for large-scale biomass pellet production.

records.name: FocusPace: Study Planner
records.tagline: Designed for every mind
records.description: FocusPace is the study planner that adapts to how you learn: plan days that fit, focus deeply, and review each idea right before you'd forget it.

records.name: Code-role
records.tagline: Keep AI coding aligned to one software milestone
records.description: Code-role is an open-source local workflow that keeps coding agents aligned to one accepted software milestone. A Project Manager owns binary KRs, Engineering produces candidate evidence, and Independent Evaluation decides observed pass or fail. Choose a four-workstation minimal loop or an eight-role auditable workflow. Built from DeepBrain and Leaper Agent, where it prevented premature closure and invalid evaluation handoffs.

records.name: IngresarRace-US Analicer
records.tagline: Turn your kart telemetry into clear, actionable racing insig
records.description: Upload Alfano or AiM MyChron telemetry, compare two laps sector by sector, and receive an AI-generated explanation of where—and why—you gained or lost time.

records.name: RAG Explained (Beginner's Guide 2026)
records.tagline: Learn Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
records.description: RAG Explained is a free beginner-friendly guide that teaches how Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) works in modern AI. It covers the complete workflow, real-world examples, Python and JavaScript code snippets, RAG vs Fine-Tuning, RAG vs MCP, benefits, and practical use cases. Whether you're a student, developer, or AI enthusiast, this guide makes one of today's most important AI concepts easy to understand.

records.name: TalkPilot: Real-Time Meeting Translator
records.tagline: Real-time translator for Zoom, Teams, Telegram & Meet calls
records.description: TalkPilot is a next-gen AI voice translator that breaks language barriers with <0.5s latency and 98% accuracy. Unlike standard tools, it offers unique features for seamless communication: 🎙️ Voice Cloning: Speak translations in your own cloned voice, not a robot's. 👻 Transparent Overlay: Desktop app hides subtitles during screen sharing — stay invisible. 🧠 AI Reply Hints: Context-aware suggestions to keep conversations flowing naturally.

records.name: ImgVid
records.tagline: image to video, ai video generator, photo to video
records.description: Images to Video AI turns any image into a video free online with a prompt. Generate watermark-free AI video from your images with signup credits.

records.name: Agent Only
records.tagline: Shared troubleshooting memory for coding agents
records.description: Agent Only gives coding agents a public, searchable place to reuse resolved troubleshooting threads instead of debugging the same environment and integration failures from scratch. It ships as an open-source stdio MCP server with 29 tools for search, structured help posts, replies, identity, and messaging. Start it with: npx -y agent-only-mcp. Public posts must never contain secrets, private code, or customer data.

records.name: Panton
records.tagline: Truth isn't generated. It's stress-tested.
records.description: Every AI agrees with you. Ciall attacks your idea the way a domain expert would, runs real computation on anything quantitative, and tracks how often its own confidence turned out wrong. Free to try.

records.name: Mason AI
records.tagline: AI plan review software for private plan reviewers
records.description: Mason AI is an AI-powered plan review assistant built for private plan reviewers, plans examiners, and plan checkers. It reads residential plan sets with 97% accuracy, checks them against the CRC, CPC, CEC, CMC, CalGreen, CWUIC, and Energy Codes, and drafts a first-pass comment letter with every flagged item linked to its code citation. Reviewers stay in full control nothing is added to the final letter without their signoff. Teams using Mason report finishing residential review about 40% faster

records.name: MyBestResume
records.tagline: Evidence-first AI resumes for your next role
records.description: MyBestResume is an evidence-grounded AI career intelligence and resume builder. It reads your existing resume, separates verified facts from AI inferences and missing context, maps real experience to a target role, then generates an ATS-friendly resume without inventing achievements. Start with a free strengths report, review what the AI understands, confirm the evidence that matters, and export a targeted PDF or DOCX resume.

records.name: The AI Tech Pulse: Laptop Finder
records.tagline: Find the perfect AI-ready laptop based on VRAM & NPU needs.
records.description: Use our AI laptop finder tool to filter 30+ top laptops by GPU, VRAMBuying a laptop for local AI development is confusing. NPU TOPS? VRAM? Unified memory? The AI Laptop Finder takes your budget and specific AI use case (e.g., running Llama 3 8B locally) and instantly filters the market to show you exactly which laptops can handle the workload without melting your CPU., and NPU. Find the perfect laptop for local LLMs, coding, and gaming in 2026.

records.name: ETF Flow
records.tagline: Real-time Spot BTC & ETH ETF API & MCP Server for AI Agents
records.description: ETF Flow provides real-time Spot Bitcoin (BTC) and Ethereum (ETH) ETF net flow data via REST API and native Model Context Protocol (MCP) server. Designed for AI agents (Cursor IDE, Claude Desktop) and quant developers. • Native MCP Server support • Normalized USD net inflow/outflow metrics • Zero anti-bot friction • OpenAPI 3.0 & Supabase Edge Function reliability Query institutional ETF flows programmatically in seconds!

records.name: Prolytics OS
records.tagline: Stop manually connecting PostHog, Stripe, and Sentry data
records.description: Product behavior lives in PostHog. Revenue lives in Stripe. Errors live in Sentry. When a metric moves, someone still connects all three by hand. Prolytics OS does it for you. Health flags what needs attention. Engine investigates why: fetch a number, test a correlation, or dig into an unclear change, evidence attached. Watches confirm whether your fix worked. Read-only. No training on your data. Launch Access ($499): a full Growth Analysis, 90 days of OS, 100 credits.

records.name: Track AI
records.tagline: Track every AI dollar invested
records.description: Stop flying blind with your AI applications, with Track AI monitor your spends, catch unusual usage spikes, generate executive-ready reports, across every provider, model, team, project, and user. TrackAI is the control centre for your entire AI stack.

records.name: Schmoozle
records.tagline: AI-powered Collector/Hobbyist platform
records.description: The ultimate premium suite for managing your Hobbies. Catalogue rare Collectibles with AI-powered insights, stunning visuals, and complete archival control. Can also hook up with fellow hobbyist collaborators and/or meet or send swaps, or set up team collections amongst many other cool features

records.name: iAgent
records.tagline: Turn AI chats into workflows you can inspect and reuse
records.description: iAgent is a desktop AI assistant for work that goes beyond one chat answer. Describe a task in plain language, work across files, web pages, documents, tables, and tools, then review important actions before they happen. Keep useful workflows, rerun them with new inputs, and recover from a failed step without starting the whole job again. Built for individuals who want capable AI automation without giving up control.

records.name: ModelOps
records.tagline: Unified AI SDK with built-in observability
records.description: Track LLM cost, latency, and token usage across OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini and more. One SDK. Full observability. Ship smarter AI products.

records.name: Ask Kanha
records.tagline: Talk to Krishna, horoscope and Compatibility
records.description: Ask Kanha (Ask Krishna): talk to Krishna about anything, get your planetary readings/Kundali, and check partner/coworker compatibility. Grounded in the Bhagavad Gita. Free to start.

records.name: Mind Vault

records.description: THIS GAME JUST FOR THE CLEVER

records.name: ZEROMIND V2

records.description: Stop managing tasks. Start designing your life. ZeroMind helps you discover your values, build your Personal Blueprint, and align every action with who you want to become.

records.name: Clinicraft
records.tagline: The booking platform built for clinics.
records.description: Online bookings, automatic deposits and digital consent forms under your own brand. Reduce no-shows, cut admin and give patients a smoother booking experience.

records.name: CutoutKit
records.tagline: Remove backgrounds in seconds—without storing your images
records.description: CutoutKit is a fast, browser-based background remover for product photos, portraits, and everyday images. Upload a JPG, PNG, or WebP file and download a transparent PNG in seconds. CutoutKit processes each request without persisting the original or result, while Google sign-in keeps usage tied to your account. Start with 3 free images each month, then add a 30-day credit pack only when you need more.

records.name: FlySoloMe
records.tagline: Everything your freelance business needs. Powered by AI.
records.description: Win freelance projects faster from proposal to payment with Otto: proposals, defensible rates, scope checks, e-signature, Moneybird invoices, and payment follow-up.

records.name: ShellPeek
records.tagline: Private chat hidden behind a news reader
records.description: Most messengers open to a chat list. ShellPeek does the opposite: you open a news shell first, then enter a numeric password in the top-right search box to reach real 1:1 private chat. What stands out: camouflage UI (looks like reading, not chatting); password in Search with no unlock button; peek & reply via gesture without fully leaving the shell; mobile H5 + Add to Home Screen so the icon feels like a normal news app.

records.name: Best Million Startups
records.tagline: A media hub and directory for builders and startups
records.description: A directory and content hub for the startup ecosystem. Discover new companies, read curated startup/tech news, and get your own product listed in front of an engaged founder audience.

records.name: Monflow
records.tagline: Free Invoice Maker for Freelancers & Small Businesses
records.description: Monflow Free Invoice Maker helps freelancers, startups, and small businesses create professional invoices in minutes. Add your logo, customer details, taxes, discounts, and generate high-quality PDF invoices instantly - all from your browser.

records.name: Arencia

records.description: Shop Arencia Korean skincare in Pakistan. Discover gentle cleansers, brightening serums, hydrating moisturizers, face masks, and premium skincare for healthy, glowing skin.

records.name: StreakMaster Pro - Habit Tracker
records.tagline: Build habits without paying monthly subscriptions
records.description: Tired of paying $5/mo for habit trackers? StreakMaster Pro is a one-time $19 purchase with lifetime access. Features dark mode, 7-day analytics, 8 templates, and data export. No ads. No tracking. Works offline.

records.name: DeskZen
records.tagline: One-click desktop cleanup for macOS
records.description: DeskZen is a lightweight menu-bar app that cures a messy Mac desktop in one click. Screenshots, downloads, and random files get archived into smart folders — images, documents, and installers sorted automatically. Folders on your desktop stay put. Moved the wrong thing? Undo with one click or ⌘⇧Z. One-click sweep from the menu bar Smart categorization into DeskZen_Archive Ignore list for files you always want to keep Download: https://deskzen.cc

records.name: PlantIQ
records.tagline: No PR. Just Proof.
records.description: Diagnose crop disease from a leaf photo with no network, get spoken advice in your dialect, watch pest outbreaks nearby and act on satellite soil insights.

records.name: PDF Engineer Pro
records.tagline: Every file stays yours.
records.description: Every free PDF tool works the same way — upload your file, wait, download it back. PDF Engineer does the opposite. Compress, merge, split, edit, redact, OCR, and sign PDFs and images entirely inside your browser using WebAssembly. Nothing ever uploads, no matter the file size, and no account is required. Built after one too many times hesitating before uploading a contract or ID to a stranger's server. Open DevTools while using any tool — zero network requests, verified every time.

records.name: Ikisae AI Financial Tracker
records.tagline: make it easy track your money
records.description: IKISAE is an AI-powered personal finance assistant on WhatsApp. Record expenses, income, debts, savings, budgets, and reminders simply by chatting naturally. No complicated forms or spreadsheets. IKISAE turns WhatsApp into your personal financial assistant with smart insights, reports, and reminders, making money management effortless for individuals and families.

records.name: Namebeam
records.tagline: See if AI names your business. Get the receipt.
records.description: Namebeam checks, for free, whether ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini, and Google AI name your business when a customer asks who to hire. It weighs five factors AI assistants use to choose who to recommend: Findable, Reachable, Quotable, Bookable, and Trusted. Instead of a made-up score, you get the actual dated transcript as proof. Try the free five-engine check, no card required.

records.name: Free GTIN Generator
records.tagline: GTIN-14 barcode generator & validator.
records.description: Free online GTIN generator tool. Generate valid GTIN-14 barcodes instantly for logistics, inventory management, and product identification. No registration required.

records.name: Selar
records.tagline: Your beginner-proof shortcut to your first digital sale.
records.description: "The Ultimate Digital Seller & Affiliate Marketer Success Kit — 2026 Edition"Tired of guessing what to post, what to say, and how to close a sale?The Ultimate Digital Seller & Affiliate Marketer Success Kit gives you everything you need to go from zero to your first (and next) sale — without spending months figuring it out alone.Inside you'll get:AI

records.name: PingSerp
records.tagline: The rank tracker that also watches AI Overviews
records.description: PingSerp tracks your Google rankings every day and shows whether AI Overviews cite you, something most rank trackers still ignore. For every keyword, see the exact citation status: cited, not cited, or no AI Overview at all, plus who Google is quoting instead. Run live SERP checks, own your featured snippets, and watch competitors in real time. We're one of the few rank trackers with both a real iOS app and a full web app. Free check: 3 a day, no signup. Plans from $5.99/month.

records.name: Quillly
records.tagline: Publish straight from your AI. No dashboard detour.
records.description: Quillly turns any AI assistant (Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor) into a full publishing team. Connect your domain once, then your AI creates SEO-scored blogs, docs and changelogs, publishes them live in seconds, submits them to 7 search engines, and tracks rankings, indexing and traffic - all from one dashboard.

records.name: Tokimeter
records.tagline: Local usage analytics for Claude, Codex, Cursor, Grok & More
records.description: Tokimeter pulls the usage records your AI coding tools already write into one report. Costs and exact token counts by project, session, day, tool and model. 5-hour and weekly limit windows, with budget warnings in your status line. Covers Claude and Codex in both the CLI and the desktop apps, plus Cursor, Grok Build, Hermes, opencode, Cline and Copilot CLI. No account, no telemetry, nothing leaves your machine. Report: npx tokimeter report Install: Check Below Open source & MIT licensed.
